items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know Buck wasn’t going there, that’s when he got Cootie Williams.

ctx.x: Did Goodman ever try to recruit you?
No, I think he tried to recruit Buck. I’m not sure. I know Buck wasn’t going there, that’s when he got Cootie Williams.
But you worked with Goodman occasionally over the years.
